notes: The flagged three-morpheme unit `לְמָעְלָה` → *upward* is genuinely indivisible: one English word carries the preposition, the adverb and the directive `he`, and no morpheme owns a part of it (rules 30, 32).
The phrase's single *the* goes to the present article morpheme on `הָאַחֲרֹנִים` rather than to the construct `דִבְרֵי`, a present morpheme taking its English before a supplied one does (rule 47).
The resuming `הֵמָּה` is the unrendered occurrence of the tripartite clause's subject, the copula joining the predicate `מִסְפַּר` (rules 20, 22).
The ASV marginal alternative *Or, in the last acts* was read and set aside (rule 38).
